description: The plot compares the accuracy of six different models—Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME—across varying co-occurrence numbers. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and employs a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to slightly beyond $10^3$, with major tick marks at 0, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 85, with visible tick marks at 60, 65, 75, and 80 (indicating an interval of 5), while the 70 mark is obscured by a grey rectangle. All six models are represented by solid lines that demonstrate a steady upward trend across four discrete data points along the x-axis. The "Base" model is represented by a black line with circle markers, increasing from an initial value of approximately 62.5 to a final value of 68.5. The "FT" model is shown as a blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers, rising from roughly 64 to 70.5. The "IKE" model is depicted by a red line with upward-pointing triangle markers, growing from about 66 to 72.5. The "MEMIT" model is represented by a purple line with hexagonal markers, starting at approximately 68 and ending at 74.5. The "MEND" model is shown as a brown line with diamond markers, increasing from roughly 69 to 77. Finally, the "ROME" model is illustrated by a green line with square markers, rising from an initial point of approximately 73 to a final value of about 81.5.
